snippet.description:
Democrats won governorships and state legislatures across the country. What could those victories mean for healthcare and abortion rights?

In this News Not Noise and Vox collaboration, @jessicayellin talks with Vox health care reporter Dylan Scott about how Democratic wins could open the door to Medicaid expansion in states like Texas and Georgia, potentially bringing health coverage to a million people.

Watch their full conversation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y0OTKFdbfcc
